query: SELECT s.series_id AS "series_id!", s.code AS "code!", s.name AS "name!", s.state AS "state!: ProviderState", (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.series_id ORDER BY s.chapter_count DESC, s.last_scanned_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.code) = 1) AS "preferred!" FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (ss.series_id, ss.provider_id) ss.series_id, p.slug AS code, p.name, CASE WHEN p.state <> 'active' THEN p.state ELSE ss.state END AS state, ss.chapter_count, ss.last_scanned_at FROM series_sources ss JOIN providers p ON p.id = ss.provider_id WHERE ss.series_id = ANY($1) ORDER BY ss.series_id, ss.provider_id, ss.chapter_count DESC, ss.last_scanned_at DESC NULLS LAST, ss.id ) s ORDER BY s.series_id, s.chapter_count DESC, s.last_scanned_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.code
